event.title: North Pole Express
event.description:
NORTH POLE EXPRESS Weekends| SATURDAYS & SUNDAYS
 DEC 5 & 6 | DEC 12 & 13 | DEC 19 & 20    Train every 45 minutes | 10:45 am | 11:30 am | 12:15 pm   | 1 pm | 1:45 pm | 2:30 pm    | 3:15 pm | 4:00 pm
 On Saturdays and Sundays, December 6th through December 15th the Boothbay Railway Village Museum will be running the “North Pole Express!” Departures will run 8 times each day beginning at 10:45am. Tickets must be purchased in advance and will only be available for purchase online.

known_violations._why: The default rules include any title no rule decides ('default include'), and nothing marks a private booking. John rejected these four in review. Listed so the gate is green on main and red on any NEW wrong verdict; delete a line when a rule change fixes it (the gate fails until you do, so the list cannot go stale).
